objective: Implement and verify a replaceable local reasoning layer using Ollama, with deterministic escalation policy and no cloud or automatic harness execution.
acceptanceCriteria: A provider-neutral local-model interface and Ollama adapter support safe probing and structured inference.
Installed models and a configurable preferred model are detected without automatic model downloads.
Inference supports structured context, timeout, cancellation, and structured failure results over loopback only.
Classification, summarization, context relevance selection, and routing recommendation tasks are available.
Deterministic policy enforces LOCAL_OK, CODING_HARNESS_REQUIRED, OWNER_INPUT_REQUIRED, and UNSURE outcomes without launching a harness.
Controlled tests prove useful context reduction and representative request classification without cloud calls.
Unavailable Ollama, failure, timeout, cancellation, and malformed output leave project state intact.
Typecheck, lint, all existing tests, and M02 acceptance tests pass.
notes: Ollama is the initial runtime unless implementation investigation reveals a strong reason to change.
The local model recommends; deterministic software owns policy and state transitions.
No model will be downloaded automatically.
nextAction: Implement the local-model boundary, Ollama adapter, local reasoning tasks, policy, CLI commands, and controlled acceptance tests.
